summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper (standard library only). Exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp dirs removed in finally). Nothing was run: tests, black, and flake8 were not executed per instructions and black/flake8 are not installed, so line lengths were checked by hand (all under 120). Nothing was committed.
